text.tspan: derived-credit
Consumer CAS reservation precedes pending exchange;
reservation survives seal and covers empty-result
completion
producer-release
Pending and wake publication plus last target access
precede release decrement; all gate modifications
remain RMW within incarnation
producer-zero
Observe closed zero through acquire and valid RMW
frontier; open zero and last contributor alone are
insufficient
storage-commit
Both gates closed and drained; exclusive pending
inspection after all claims/root handoffs; native
empty receipt is not whole VM retirement
consumer-reserve
One coherent open/count snapshot and CAS; close
invalidates stale snapshot; reservation count not
inferred from pending bit
root-spill
R1 may be a C local and SELF may become live
carrier; spill selected carrier before GC and
publish correct root location
root-reload
Collector rewrites scanned slot; reload live carrier
before use; local R1 is not automatically a
collector root
consumer-zero
Seal consumer gate only after producer closed-zero
receipt; observe drained reservations and preserve
deferred/unknown/root custody

g.text: SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source + platform OPEN

text.tspan: gate-cost
Protocol counts only; SC is initial profile and weaker
order is not admitted; existing flags already coalesce
final-check
No single zero or last decrement licenses VM cleanup;
root/native/roster receipts remain necessary
root-cost
Direct PSTATE registers need no extra local spill; k
comes from effective masks/configuration, not an
assumed constant
net-condition
No runtime speed or build-time benefit established;
modern C is sufficient to express the contract; Zig
removes none of these obligations
